title: Sammy Sosa Donruss Leaf 1990 #489 Chicago Cubs - Wrong Birthday Rookie Card (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
His birthday is actually 11-12-1968.

This is a Sammy Sosa Donruss Leaf 1990 #489 Chicago Cubs trading card. It is a wrong birthday rookie card (RC) made of standard card stock material. The card is a licensed reprint from the 1990 Major League (MLB) season. The card features the base set and has a 20 pt. thickness. 

The card is in English language and is not autographed. It is not a custom bundle and is not vintage. The card manufacturer is Donruss and it is part of the 1990 Donruss set. The card is of the Chicago White Sox team and has the card number #249. This card is perfect for any baseball fan who is looking for a piece of memorabilia from the 1990 MLB season.
